Return to the cellar

The sounds of Legacy

Real people recorded the paper, footsteps, leather, and distant bus you hear here. These recordings are included with the page; listening sends nothing to another service.

A bus beyond the door

“Bus horn short.wav” by arundasstp, licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0. Recorded in Kozhikode, Kerala, India. We lower and soften it, place it outside the room, and add the room’s echo to suggest distance. No endorsement by the recordist is implied.

The turning page

“Page Turn” by davidbain, released under CC0 1.0. Played more slowly, with a little room echo and movement across the book.

Shoes on the floorboards

“Footsteps on wood” by ChloePieterse, released under CC0 1.0. Recorded with an Audio Technica AT2020USB microphone. Individual footsteps are excerpted and placed beneath the visitor as they move.

The old leather binding

“Leather Creak / Stretching” by IENBA, released under CC0 1.0. A leather belt twisted and stretched, recorded with a Zoom H4n and Sennheiser MKE600. Excerpts are slowed and layered as the binding opens.

The room air, clock, door bell, music-box notes, revelation harmony, and room echo are made in the browser. The four recordings above are publicly offered high-quality MP3 previews from Freesound. Source and file details.
